capability.write-tests-first: Starts a behaviour change by verifying the expected result.
capability.verify-work-results: Confirms the result with checks that were actually run.
capability.plan-implementation: Breaks a requirement into sequential, executable tasks.
capability.debug-root-cause: Establishes the original cause of a failure.
capability.clarify-requirements: Clarifies the goal, the boundaries and the acceptance criteria.
capability.review-code: Brings in an independent review of a defined change.
capability.apply-review-feedback: Fixes confirmed review findings and checks the consequences.
capability.isolate-workspace: Separates a new change from other work.
capability.integrate-branch: Integrates a finished change into the agreed branch.
capability.parallelize-tasks: Runs independent tasks at the same time.
capability.delegate-subagent-tasks: Hands clearly bounded tasks to other executors.
capability.minimize-code-surface: Keeps the implementation to the smallest complete set of changes.
capability.execute-plan: Executes the agreed plan task by task, with check evidence.
capability.author-agent-instructions: Writes and verifies the instructions that steer an agent behaviour.
capability.harden-validation: Adds checks at every data boundary after the cause is removed.
capability.read-large-artifacts: Reads large artifacts in parts without overflowing the context.
capability.redact-sensitive-data: Replaces sensitive values with placeholders before sharing.
capability.diagnose-agent-behavior: Establishes from evidence what happened during the work.
capability.consult-guidance: Checks for applicable guidance before acting.
capability.automate-rule-enforcement: Moves mechanically checkable rules into automation.
capability.communicate-concisely: Delivers the result concisely and on the point.
capability.define-output-format: Fixes the exact sections, order and fields of the result.
capability.audit-codebase: Rates the whole repository by the impact of the findings, not by one change.
capability.manage-technical-debt: Keeps deferred shortcuts in a ledger with their review conditions.
capability.design-structure: Ability to choose the data shape, module boundaries and interaction structure before writing code.
capability.make-states-unrepresentable: Ability to move the rules for valid states into a type and constructor so an illegal state cannot be created.
capability.measure-performance: Ability to measure a metric reproducibly and explain the number together with the baseline and variance.
capability.design-experiments: Ability to compare design or instruction variants on the same tasks and the same criterion.
capability.write-technical-prose: Ability to write technical prose that answers in the first paragraph and carries no template noise.
capability.explain-subsystem: Ability to explain part of a system through its purpose, its boundary and its main execution path.
capability.build-verification-harness: Ability to build and maintain scenarios that prove the product's observable behavior.
capability.triage-reports: Ability to classify incoming reports and findings and route each by class.
capability.coordinate-program: Ability to split large work into parts with an owner, dependencies and merge points.
capability.keep-decision-trail: Ability to record a decision with its options, grounds and review condition.
capability.research-primary-sources: Investigate a question against the sources that own it and record cited findings.
capability.model-domain-language: Sharpen the project's shared terminology and record the decisions about it.
capability.teach-with-workspace: Teach a concept over sessions using a stateful workspace.
capability.author-setup-scripts: Generate an interactive script that walks a human through a manual procedure.

pattern.approval-policy-proceed: Approval policy: do the agreed work and stop only at an irreversible step.
pattern.approval-policy-gate: Approval policy: size the work first, then ask for approval.
pattern.test-first-development: Verifies the expected behaviour first, then adds the implementation.
pattern.verification-before-completion: Backs every claim with fresh check results.
pattern.implementation-planning: Organises dependent steps into a verifiable plan.
pattern.systematic-debugging: Finds and confirms the root cause before fixing anything.
pattern.requirements-clarification: Establishes the need and agrees the direction before design.
pattern.code-review: Rates a change independently against the requirements.
pattern.worktree-isolation: Separates development in its own worktree.
pattern.branch-integration: Checks finished work before the agreed integration.
pattern.parallel-execution: Runs independent work at the same time without shared state.
pattern.subagent-delegation: Hands a bounded task over and checks its result.
pattern.code-minimization: Satisfies the requirement with the smallest complete change.
pattern.plan-execution: Runs the plan in order, with a decision log and a check per task.
pattern.instruction-authoring: Creates agent instructions through a basic check and iteration.
pattern.defense-in-depth: Makes the failure impossible with checks on several levels.
pattern.bounded-artifact-reading: Bounds reading and output by the size of the artifact.
pattern.evidence-redaction: Keeps the artifact evidential without its sensitive values.
pattern.evidence-analysis: Analyzes execution artifacts from evidence, not from guesses.
pattern.guidance-selection: Selects applicable guidance before work begins.
pattern.automated-enforcement: Replaces manual reminders with a check.
pattern.concise-communication: Delivers the result without preamble or repetition.
pattern.output-formatting: Fixes the shape of the result before it exists.
pattern.code-audit: Reviews the whole repository in a stable order of impact.
pattern.technical-debt: Makes deferred decisions visible and traceable.
pattern.structural-design: An approach in which the data structure and module boundaries determine the shape of the code.
pattern.state-modeling: An approach in which valid states are described by a type rather than by a set of checks.
pattern.performance-measurement: An approach in which a change is judged by measurement with a baseline and variance.
pattern.experiment-design: An approach in which variants are compared on the same tasks and the same criterion.
pattern.technical-writing: An approach in which technical prose is built around the thesis, an example and the reader's question.
pattern.subsystem-explanation: An approach in which a subsystem is explained from its purpose to its main path.
pattern.verification-harness: An approach in which product behavior is proven by a reproducible set of scenarios.
pattern.report-triage: An approach in which incoming reports are classified and routed by one rule.
pattern.program-orchestration: An approach in which large work proceeds in parts with explicit owners and dependencies.
pattern.decision-trail: An approach in which decisions are recorded together with their grounds and review condition.
pattern.approval-policy: An approach in which the approval policy is chosen by user configuration while both opposite policies are stated explicitly.
pattern.domain-language: An approach in which the project's shared terms are sharpened and used consistently.
pattern.teaching-workspace: An approach in which learning is grounded in a persistent workspace and the learner's level.
pattern.setup-scripting: An approach in which a manual procedure is turned into a guided, verifiable script.
pattern.progressive-disclosure: An approach in which material is placed on a hierarchy so the top stays legible and reference is reached by a pointer.
pattern.completion-criteria: An approach in which every step ends on a condition that tells the executor the work is done.
pattern.expand-contract: An approach in which a wide refactor adds the new form, migrates callers in batches, then deletes the old form.
pattern.vertical-slicing: An approach in which work proceeds as narrow complete paths through every layer.
pattern.explore-then-exploit: An approach in which raw material is mined before structure is committed.
